description: Persistence PersistedData v2 + v1->v2 migration in src/persistence/store.ts (the only AsyncStorage importer), plus migrating/extending the store tests. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (imports RewardsState/emptyRewards) and FEAT-002 (imports PriorQuestionAttempt/PriorPracticeAttempt types). Preserves existing progression, awards NO retroactive XP, keeps STORAGE_KEY 'goalie.v1'.
steps: In src/persistence/store.ts keep STORAGE_KEY = 'goalie.v1' with a comment that the slot name is intentionally unchanged (document.version drives migration). Add PERSISTED_VERSION = 2. Import emptyRewards + RewardsState from ../domain/rewards and PriorQuestionAttempt/PriorPracticeAttempt from ../domain/coaching.

Add interface PersistedDataV1 (the current shape: version:1, selectedTrackId, displayName, progression) retained for migration-input typing. Change PersistedData to v2: { version:2; selectedTrackId; displayName; progression: ProgressionState; rewards: RewardsState; attemptHistory: { questions: Record<string, PriorQuestionAttempt>; practice: Record<string, PriorPracticeAttempt> }; aiCoaching: PersistedAiCoaching }. Add interface PersistedAiCoaching { enabled: boolean; endpointUrl: string | null; disclosureAcknowledged: boolean }.

Update defaultPersistedData() to the full v2 shape: version:2, selectedTrackId:null, displayName:null, progression: emptyProgression(), rewards: emptyRewards(), attemptHistory:{questions:{},practice:{}}, aiCoaching:{enabled:false,endpointUrl:null,disclosureAcknowledged:false}.

Make loadData version-aware (design 5.2): key absent -> defaultPersistedData(); parsed with version===2 passing the v2 guard -> return as-is; version===1 passing a v1 guard -> migrate (carry selectedTrackId/displayName/progression verbatim, init rewards=emptyRewards(), empty attemptHistory, default aiCoaching; NO retroactive XP; saveData the migrated v2 doc ONCE; return it); unparseable OR shape-invalid at its declared version OR unknown/future version (e.g. 3) -> defaultPersistedData() + single console.warn('goalie: discarding unreadable store').

Extend the structural guard (keep the existing progression predicate unchanged): rewards is a plain object with version===2; awardedXp is a plain object whose every value is a number in {20,50}; totalXp is a non-negative integer and, if it disagrees with sum(values(awardedXp)), RE-DERIVE totalXp from the ledger and emit one console.warn('goalie: recomputed xp total') (do not reject the store); streak.count non-negative integer; streak.lastLocalDateYYYYMMDD null or an 8-digit string; earnedBadges an array of non-empty strings (de-duped on load). attemptHistory.questions/.practice plain objects; each question record { integer selectedIndex, boolean correct, integer atEpochMs }, each practice record { boolean hadText, integer atEpochMs }; a malformed record is DROPPED (not the whole store) with one console.warn('goalie: dropped malformed attempt history'). aiCoaching plain object with boolean enabled, boolean disclosureAcknowledged, endpointUrl null|string; a malformed aiCoaching RESETS to the default off setting with one console.warn('goalie: reset ai-coaching setting'); coerce enabled->false SILENTLY (no warn) when disclosureAcknowledged !== true.
Leave saveData/clearData contracts unchanged (one JSON string under the one key; clearData removes it, wiping everything).

In __tests__/store.test.ts: REWRITE the pre-existing v1-shaped round-trip and the two deletion cases to the v2 shape via defaultPersistedData() (build inputs from the full v2 default, not v1 literals) so they stay green. Keep the existing corrupt-store warn cases (they exercise invalid-at-declared-version). Add design section 8 items 18-25d: migrate v1->v2 preserves progression + inits empty rewards/history + writes back (a second loadData returns version===2); no retroactive XP (totalXp===0, empty awardedXp) even when v1 had completed levels; v2 round-trip equality with no warn; totalXp disagreement re-derives + one 'recomputed xp total' warn; corrupt rewards (xp value 37) -> defaults + discard warn; malformed attempt record dropped but authoritative rewards/progression kept + one dropped-history warn; unknown version:3 -> defaults + discard warn; clearData wipes v2 -> load equals defaults; aiCoaching round-trip (enabled+endpoint+acknowledged survive); enable-without-ack coercion to false (silent, no warn); malformed aiCoaching reset + one 'reset ai-coaching setting' warn with authoritative data preserved; v1->v2 inits aiCoaching to default off/un-acknowledged.
acceptance_criteria: PersistedData is version 2 with rewards/attemptHistory/aiCoaching; defaultPersistedData() returns the full v2 shape; PERSISTED_VERSION === 2; STORAGE_KEY is still the literal 'goalie.v1'.

A stored v1 document migrates to v2 preserving progression, awards no XP (totalXp 0, empty ledger), and is written back exactly once; a corrupt/unknown document falls back to defaults with one discard warn.
The guard re-derives a disagreeing totalXp, drops only malformed non-authoritative history/aiCoaching, and coerces enabled->false without an acknowledged disclosure.
src/persistence/store.ts remains the only module importing AsyncStorage.
Running `npm test -- store` passes all rewritten and new cases.
verification: npm run lint   clean on src/persistence/store.ts and __tests__/store.test.ts
findings:
Implemented in src/persistence/store.ts (still the ONLY AsyncStorage importer). STORAGE_KEY stays the literal 'goalie.v1' (slot name intentionally unchanged; document.version drives migration). Added PERSISTED_VERSION = 2. Imports emptyRewards/RewardsState from ../domain/rewards and PriorQuestionAttempt/PriorPracticeAttempt from ../domain/coaching.

EXACT v2 shapes FEAT-004/FEAT-005 must bind to:
- interface PersistedDataV1 { version: 1; selectedTrackId: string | null; displayName: string | null; progression: ProgressionState }  (retained for migration-input typing only)
- interface PersistedAiCoaching { enabled: boolean; endpointUrl: string | null; disclosureAcknowledged: boolean }
- interface PersistedData { version: 2; selectedTrackId: string | null; displayName: string | null; progression: ProgressionState; rewards: RewardsState; attemptHistory: { questions: Record<string, PriorQuestionAttempt>; practice: Record<string, PriorPracticeAttempt> }; aiCoaching: PersistedAiCoaching }

defaultPersistedData() returns EXACTLY: { version: 2, selectedTrackId: null, displayName: null, progression: emptyProgression(), rewards: emptyRewards(), attemptHistory: { questions: {}, practice: {} }, aiCoaching: { enabled: false, endpointUrl: null, disclosureAcknowledged: false } }.

loadData() is version-aware: key absent -> defaultPersistedData(); version===2 passing guardV2 -> returned (with at-most-once repair warns applied); version===1 passing the v1 guard -> migrated (selectedTrackId/displayName/progression carried verbatim, rewards=emptyRewards(), empty attemptHistory, default-off aiCoaching, NO retroactive XP), saveData'd back ONCE (silent, no warn), returned; unparseable / shape-invalid at declared version / unknown-or-future version (e.g. 3) -> defaultPersistedData() + single console.warn('goalie: discarding unreadable store').

Structural guard (guardV2) warn/repair contract (binding for callers that re-read):
- AUTHORITATIVE (reject whole store -> defaults + 'goalie: discarding unreadable store'): bad outer version, bad selectedTrackId/displayName type, invalid progression (Phase 2 predicate unchanged), rewards not a plain object / rewards.version!==2 / awardedXp not a plain object / any awardedXp value not in {20,50} / totalXp not a non-negative integer / streak not a plain object / streak.count not a non-negative integer / lastLocalDateYYYYMMDD not (null | 8-digit string) / earnedBadges not an array of non-empty strings / attemptHistory(.questions/.practice) not plain objects.
- NON-AUTHORITATIVE repairs (store kept): totalXp !== sum(values(awardedXp)) -> re-derive totalXp from the ledger + one console.warn('goalie: recomputed xp total'); earnedBadges de-duplicated on load (order preserved); any malformed attemptHistory question record ({ integer selectedIndex, boolean correct, integer atEpochMs }) or practice record ({ boolean hadText, integer atEpochMs }) -> that record DROPPED (store kept) + at-most-once console.warn('goalie: dropped malformed attempt history'); malformed aiCoaching (not a plain object, or enabled/disclosureAcknowledged not boolean, or endpointUrl not null|string) -> RESET to { enabled:false, endpointUrl:null, disclosureAcknowledged:false } + at-most-once console.warn('goalie: reset ai-coaching setting').
- SILENT safety coercion (no warn): a well-formed aiCoaching with enabled===true but disclosureAcknowledged!==true loads with enabled coerced to false (AI path can never run without an acknowledged disclosure). endpointUrl/disclosureAcknowledged are preserved as stored.

saveData/clearData contracts unchanged: one JSON string under STORAGE_KEY; clearData removes that one key (wipes progression, rewards, attemptHistory, aiCoaching, displayName, selectedTrackId together — no orphaned keys).

Incidental non-test edit required to keep typecheck green under v2: src/ui/context/ProgressionProvider.tsx deleteAllData() previously built an inline v1 PersistedData literal ({version:1,...emptyProgression()}); replaced with setData(defaultPersistedData()) (identical reset semantics, now v2-correct) and removed the now-unused emptyProgression import. FEAT-004 owns the full provider rewiring and can rebuild on top of this.

Tests: __tests__/store.test.ts rewritten to the v2 shape (round-trip + both deletion cases built from defaultPersistedData() spreads; pre-existing corrupt-store warn cases kept as invalid-at-declared-version) plus design section 8 items 18-25d added (migrate+write-back, no-retro-XP, v2 round-trip no-warn, totalXp re-derive+warn, corrupt xp=37 discard, malformed history-record drop, unknown version:3 discard, clearData wipe, aiCoaching round-trip, enable-without-ack silent coercion, malformed aiCoaching reset+warn, migration inits aiCoaching off).

Verification green: npm run typecheck exit 0; npm test -- store = 17 passed; npm run lint exit 0 (only the 2 pre-existing require-import WARNINGS in __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx and __tests__/store.test.ts — the AsyncStorage jest-mock registration — unchanged by this feature).
